# KuramotoInspiredInterconnect

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
An interconnect design principle where chip-to-chip communication is modeled after Kuramoto oscillator coupling, enabling emergent synchronization across the network. Provides a theoretical foundation for designing TCC topologies that naturally support temporal alignment and cooperative processing across chiplets.
